 & S.G. Chapalgaonkar, Jj.
 Date : 13 January 2023
Order :
This is an application for bringing on record LRs of original petitioner with a prayer to condone the delay.
For the reasons mentioned in the application and taking into account the fact that petition is awaiting admission and is for compensation under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
LRs are allowed to be brought on record.
Amendment be carried out within two weeks.

[S.G. CHAPALGAONKAR, J] [MANGESH S. PATIL, J] grt/-
